question: Should the credential-separated, fail-closed repair publication architecture become the production repair pipeline as one guarded rollout?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but it deliberately changes privileged workflow topology and operational failure behavior; accepting that boundary and owning its rollout requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Merge with a named monitor, verified production token and ruleset assumptions, representative live-run observation, and a rollback path.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Land staged proof, credential isolation, and lifecycle recovery separately to reduce the operational blast radius.

options.title: Retain current pipeline
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers are prepared to own the stricter fail-closed production boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Merge with a named monitor, verified production token and ruleset assumptions, representative live-run observation, and a rollback path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current validation surface and authored the final architecture and recovery hardening, making them the best available owner for the rollout decision.
